evaluation.evaluation_mode: Held-Out Benchmark Validation + Scene Geometry Audit (No Scene Ground-Truth Supplied)
evaluation.footprint_area_error_status: Not validated for this scene (no reference footprint vector layer uploaded)

held_out_benchmark.dataset: IEEE GRSS DFC2019 Track 1 (Jacksonville, FL & Omaha, NE)
held_out_benchmark.split_protocol: Spatially non-overlapping 90% train / 10% held-out validation tiles (every 10th tile held out)

evaluation.evaluation_notes: Reported IoU (0.775) and Object Height MAE (3.91 m) are measured on held-out DFC2019 validation tiles. Upload reference GeoJSON footprints or LiDAR control points to compute scene-specific ground-truth errors.
